reuse.why: Extends the single existing isNonWorkingDay predicate, which every holiday-aware path (getDateWithSkippedWeekend, and through it getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, the schedule template) already uses.

duplication.why: Adds one small isHoliday helper and no repeated logic.

placement.why: The holiday matching rule stays in shared/schedules.ts next to the predicate it extends.

scope.why: A three-line source change plus focused tests.

maintainability.why: Simple and in one place; matching `MM-DD` by `day.slice(5)` relies implicitly on the YYYY-MM-DD format, which a short comment or named helper would make explicit.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The change is made inside isNonWorkingDay's helper; no caller is touched.
